# Pinned editor runtime notices

M3-04 promotes the already locked model/state/history/view packages to runtime dependencies. Their exact installed license texts are retained below; versions and package resolutions are unchanged. Transform, orderedmap and rope-sequence are the existing transitive runtime dependencies. These MIT notices cover this editor dependency set, not the complete app/native distribution review (M6). No library performs filesystem, account or network operations here.
